answer: Rotating Cipher Quorum Pricing. Each identity gets a rotating cipher token; every additional agent a coordinator wants counted in one voting round doubles the token price for that round, tracked on a public spiral ledger. Attackers must acquire fresh tokens across many rounds, paying exponentially per identity. A violet flag marks clusters sharing timing fingerprints, freezing their tokens for audit. Cost: each sybil identity pays multiplying round fees plus forfeiture risk.
